title: Taiwan to see good weather on election day: CWA
summary: Taipei, Nov. 27 (CNA) Mostly cloudy to sunny skies are forecast across Taiwan on Saturday, when local elections will be held, although temperatures are expected to be cooler overnight, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).

title: What to know about the latest U.S. tariff proposals for Taiwan
summary: Taipei, Nov. 26 (CNA) The United States on Wednesday proposed tariffs of up to 15 percent on Taiwanese goods, including existing duties, following an investigation into manufacturing overcapacity under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, with a final decision expected next year after further consultations.

title: Vice premier outlines tariffs, support for U.S. investments by Taiwan firms
summary: Taipei, Nov. 26 (CNA) Vice Premier Cheng Li-chiun (鄭麗君) said Thursday that Taiwan has secured preferential treatment under potential U.S. semiconductor tariffs and is helping companies expanding there obtain tariff exemptions and investment support.

title: Premier Cho calls for vigilance against cyberattacks ahead of elections
summary: Taipei, Nov. 26 (CNA) Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) on Thursday urged the relevant authorities to remain vigilant against anticipated cyberattacks to safeguard the integrity of Taiwan's upcoming local government elections.

title: Mostly stable weather forecast for Taiwan on election day
summary: Taipei, Nov. 26 (CNA) Taiwan will see scattered showers on Thursday, but the rain will give way to mostly sunny to partly cloudy skies by Saturday, election day, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).
